criteria.evidence: The local database was rebuilt from migrations only; the final supabase db reset --no-seed exited 0. The full pgTAP suite passed all 116 assertions. The focused PostgREST/RPC integration test passed and proved Admin A's first publish, Admin B's later edit, republish and unpublish, and exact selection of immutable revisions one and two.

The focused real service-role API test passed photograph attachment, position 3, inline placement and cover selection; Admin B's replacement retained position, placement and draft cover meaning; revision one kept the old photograph until republish; revision two selected the new photograph; and Letter publication returned PR004B_LETTER_PUBLICATION_FORBIDDEN.

The focused production-server Playwright test passed 1/1 in desktop Chromium and 1/1 in mobile Chrome. In both projects a synthetic published Chapters detail rendered through the real Next.js route, logout returned 303, immediate Back stayed on family-login, and the exposure detector found no private surface or detail text.

After browser verification, a final migrations-only local reset succeeded. An independent read-only local API reconciliation reported users=0, content=0, media=0, associations=0, objects=0 and throttle=0. No canonical Home or First Days seed records or email delivery were used.

TypeScript passed; the Next.js 16.3.0 production build compiled, type-checked and generated all 17 static pages while leaving next-env.d.ts unchanged; npm production audit reported 0 vulnerabilities; and git diff --check reported no whitespace errors. Unrelated lint and test suites were intentionally not rerun.

The installed scope gate validated the approved contract, captured the 86-path dirty baseline with zero staged files, and passed the final four-file task delta: three new local-only test/config files and one allowed Playwright configuration change. This result is used to close both ledgers.

deviations: Docker Desktop initially failed its WSL bootstrap with 0xc00000fd and broken localhost forwarding. A Docker-only restart recovered the local engine; no repository, remote service or production state was changed.

Early reset attempts rebuilt the database and applied every migration but returned a transient Storage EOF during container restart. The authoritative final supabase db reset --no-seed completed with exit code 0.
The first focused integration attempt hit Windows VirtualAlloc before tests started. The unchanged test reached execution with a 512 MB heap and one worker.

Two local test-harness assumptions were corrected within allowed test scope: a request-scoped Next.js loader was replaced by direct PostgREST selected-revision inspection, and publication selection was keyed to active_published_revision_id rather than the legacy status field. No product defect or product file change resulted.
Supabase and build/browser checks were run sequentially, and non-required local Supabase services were excluded, to stay within available laptop memory.
No unrelated test suite was rerun because the focused verification found no product defect.
next_action: Stop after project and global ledger closure. This is local re-verification only; do not commit, push, deploy, access remote Supabase or claim production proof.
